{{Quote|With ''state-of-the-art'' defensive, offensive and subterfuge weapon systems, the Venomator is the ''last word'' in reducing your enemies to a pile of smoking chump!|[[Clawfish]]|<ref name="Under the Hammer" />}}
The '''''Venomator''''' was a highly advanced [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] designed by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] known as [[Bogg]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|This ''beauty'' is loaded for ''bear''! A lot more than ''bear'' actually...|[[T'orn Zorc]]|<ref name="Under the Hammer" />}}
[[File:Venomator_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Venomator''{{'s}} main weapon in action]]
The ''Venomator'' was equipped with state-of-the-art defensive, offensive and subterfuge weapon systems. It featured [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] that could shoot in all directions, [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]], as well as a heavy laser cannon sticking out from the rest of the ship.<ref name="Under the Hammer" />

==History==
{{Quote|This ''weapon'' is too ''dangerous'' to be set loose...|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]|<ref name="Under the Hammer" />}}
The ''Venomator'' was last surviving creation of the infamous [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Bogg]]. Some time after his [[Battle of Makem Te (Clone Wars)|incarceration]], the ''Venomator'' was owned by [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] [[Clawfish]], who planned to sell it to the highest bidder in his [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Clawfish Roaming Auction of Illicit and Illegal Weaponry|operation]] on [[Callos]].<ref name="Under the Hammer" />

In around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] went on a [[Mission to Callos|mission]] to Callos to prevent the ''Venomator'' from falling into the wrong hands. However, the illegal auction was interrupted by [[T'orn Zorc]] and [[Black Sun foot soldier/Legends|his soldiers]] who claimed the craft. The theft of the ship would have earned Zorc serious support, as he was planning on making a power play for control of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. The [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen's]] efforts were eventually foiled by [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] Zorc and destroyed the ''Venomator'' with [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|her lightsabers]], since he was deemed too unpredictable to be allowed to rule.<ref name="Under the Hammer" />
